examples.text: 1912, Martin Luther, Lutherbibel von 1912, 2 Chronicles 7:1 (with KJV translation)
examples.translation: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the fire came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the Lord filled the house.
examples.english: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the fire came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the Lord filled the house.
